source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of 'Network Bandwidth' (PDF 19): the same text in simple Roman Urdu with glossed hard words, a self-check and a recap.

blocks.text: Network bandwidth woh miqdar (amount) hai jitna data ek muqarrar waqt mein bheja jata hai. Yeh batati hai ke network kitna data carry kar (utha) sakta hai. Bandwidth aam taur par Mbps (megabits per second) mein napi jati hai. Zyada bandwidth ka matlab tez data transfer hai. Zyada devices zyada bandwidth istemal karte hain. Kam bandwidth se internet speed slow ho sakti hai.

blocks.title: Bandwidth aur asal raftar
blocks.text: Bandwidth link ki zyada se zyada raftar hai. Asal mein jo raftar milti hai (throughput) woh aksar kam hoti hai, kyunke link bohat se devices share karte hain aur deri aur ghaltiyan bhi hoti hain.
Yeh program hisaab lagata hai ke diye gaye bandwidth par ek file download hone mein kitna waqt lagega. file_size_mb ya bandwidth_mbps badal kar Run karein.

file_size_mb = 100
bandwidth_mbps = 20

file_size_megabits = file_size_mb * 8
seconds = file_size_megabits / bandwidth_mbps
print("File size:", file_size_megabits, "megabits")
print("Time to download:", seconds, "seconds")

blocks.title: Code Explanation (Wazahat)
blocks.text:
"file_size_mb = 100": file ka size 100 MB (megabytes). "bandwidth_mbps = 20": internet ki raftar 20 Mbps (megabits per second).
"file_size_megabits = file_size_mb * 8": 1 byte = 8 bits, is liye 100 MB = 800 megabits.
"seconds = file_size_megabits / bandwidth_mbps": 800 / 20 = 40.0 seconds; "/" decimal number deta hai.
Output: "File size: 800 megabits" aur "Time to download: 40.0 seconds".
Khud try karein: bandwidth_mbps = 40 kar ke Run karein: waqt aadha, 20.0 seconds ho jata hai. Yani zyada bandwidth = tez transfer.

blocks.prompt: 100 MB file 20 Mbps par kitni der mein download hogi? (Bytes aur bits ka farq yaad rakhein.)
blocks.explanation: 100 MB = 800 megabits; 800 / 20 = 40 seconds (asal mein thora zyada, kyun ke link share hota hai).

items: Bandwidth: muqarrar waqt mein kitna data (Mbps); zyada bandwidth = tez transfer; zyada devices zyada bandwidth lete hain.
